fnol_text: My name is Arjun Oyelaran and I live at 639 Juniper Place, Riverton, WY 82528. You can reach me on (555) 259-2632 or arjun.oyelaran@example.com. On 20 April 2026 I tried to drive through a flooded road under the bridge. The water was deeper than I thought and the engine cut out and filled with water. Policy MT-2023-00041. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Oyelaran on (555) 259-2632 to acknowledge the claim. Arjun confirmed the loss date as 20 April 2026.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Mateo Castillo gave a statement by phone.
Arjun sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
